recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up source work is needed for FHIR-11267 unless a future work group decision separately changes the XHTML narrative constraint language.
issue_request: FHIR-11267 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core technical correction against the 2016 September narrative page. It reported that the Narrative XHTML constraint sentence was duplicated, once for attributes and once for elements, and was auto-approved as a non-substantive duplicate-removal issue.
initial_application: The issue was applied by git commit a97f5b841010d1dd27ca9a19518df05e296fe023, whose git-svn-id records build@10319 matching the Jira comments. That commit removed the separate duplicate attributes invariant row from source/datatypes/narrative.xml and merged the element and attribute checks into one Narrative.div invariant.
additional_context: Narrative remains in current build scope as an infrastructure type with narrative/xhtml mapped to the narrative page in source/fhir.ini. Current source/narrative.html states the XHTML content rule once, and current source/datatypes/narrative.xml has one combined elements-and-attributes invariant. Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting or clarifying community record.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit on the combined branch. No source edit was needed because the duplicate has already been removed and rewording the current constraint would be redundant for this issue.
